reasoning_notes.reasoning: With no history and symmetric firms, choose a quantity near the one-shot Cournot best response: against two quantities around 8, the best response is 8. This balances margin and market share.

With no history and simultaneous choices, 8 balances price and volume if rivals produce moderate quantities; against two similar firms, total output near 24 yields price 6, so consider a cautious quantity to avoid costly overproduction.
With no history and symmetric firms, 6 is a reasonable opening quantity: it limits exposure to a low market price while leaving room to benefit if rivals produce less.
Their combined output was 14, so 7 yields price 9 and profit 21. Given the last price and quantities, this is a reasonable profitable adjustment while avoiding excessive output.
Their combined output was 14. Against that, 7 units yields price 9 and profit 21, slightly more than 6 units yields 8 and profit 12; higher quantities reduce my profit.

With rivals’ combined output at 16, producing 6 gives price 2 and profit -24, while producing 0 avoids a loss. A moderate positive quantity can pay if rivals cut output, and prior round suggests matching 6 is plausible.

With rivals producing 13, output 7 makes total quantity 20 and price 10, yielding profit 28. Nearby choices earn less: 6 yields 24 and 8 yields 24. Matching my previous quantity also supports stable repeated play.
The others produced 13 last round, so 7 gives price 10 and profit 28. Matching my prior quantity keeps a profitable, measured output while avoiding the lower price from expanding.

In round 2, each rival produced 7, and my 6 earned 24. Against 14 rival units, producing 7 yields price 9 and profit 21; producing 6 yields 24. Choose 6 for higher immediate profit while matching my prior output.
With rivals at 14 combined, 7 units gives price 9 and profit 21. Nearby choices yield less against that output; recent rival production is consistently around 13–14.

The others have consistently produced about 13–14 units combined. Against 14, producing 5 maximizes single-round profit, but repeated play favors sustaining the observed 7-unit pattern; it has earned positive profit each round and signals continued coordination.

The other firms have settled near 14 combined units. Producing 7 gives price 9 and profit 21; matching their recent quantities avoids a potentially costly unilateral increase while preserving the repeated-game pattern.

Rivals have repeatedly chosen 7 each, so 7 yields profit (9−6)×7 = 21 if they repeat. Deviating upward risks lowering market price enough to reduce my profit; matching is a robust choice across repeated rounds.
Both rivals have repeatedly produced 7, making total output 21 and price 9. Matching 7 yields profit 21; against their observed combined 14, this is my best response.
Both rivals chose 7 in each of the last two rounds. Against their combined 14 units, 7 yields price 9 and profit 21; nearby quantities earn less, so matching is the best response.
The others have settled at 14 combined output. Producing 7 gives price 9 and profit 21; moving quantity by one would lower my profit if their output stays fixed.
The rivals have repeatedly settled at 7 each. Against their combined 14 units, 7 yields price 9 and profit 21; changing quantity alone lowers my profit.
With rivals producing 14, quantity 7 gives price 9 and profit 21. Nearby quantities yield less: 6 earns 18, while 8 earns 16. Repeated coordination at 7 suggests sticking with it.
The repeated 7-7-7 outcome yields steady profit of 21 each. With rivals producing 14 total, matching 7 maintains that outcome; changing output risks a lower return without evidence of a lasting gain.
The firms have repeatedly held at 7 each. Given the others' combined 14 units, producing 7 yields profit 21; changing quantity would earn less if they maintain their pattern.
With the other firms at 14, producing 7 keeps the price at 9 and earns 21. Deviating by one unit lowers my profit; repeated outcomes suggest they may sustain this choice.

The others have repeatedly maintained a combined quantity of 14. Matching 7 gives profit 21; deviating down sacrifices profit if they hold steady, while increasing output lowers market price enough to reduce my profit.

The others have repeatedly produced 14 combined. At that total, 7 yields price 9 and profit 21; deviating upward or downward earns less if their output stays unchanged. Repeated coordination supports maintaining 7.

The others have repeated 7 each for five rounds. At their combined 14, my best response is 7: it yields (30−14−7−6)×7 = 21, while nearby quantities earn less. Repeated cooperation also supports holding steady.
The others have repeatedly held at 7 each. Matching 7 preserves the established high-profit outcome and avoids triggering a quantity war that could lower profits over many rounds.
Both rivals have held at 7 for six rounds. Matching 7 preserves the established outcome and yields 21; a one-unit increase would lower price enough to reduce my profit.
Both rivals have held output at 7 for six rounds. With their combined 14 units, producing 7 yields price 9 and profit 21; changing output would reduce my profit against that stable pattern.
The other firms have repeatedly produced 14 combined, making 7 a stable best response: it earns 21 at price 9. Deviating to 6 or 8 earns less if their output stays unchanged.
The other firms have repeatedly produced 7 each, making 7 a stable best response to their combined 14 units: it yields 21 profit, more than any other quantity against that total.
The others have repeatedly produced 14 combined, so 7 keeps total output at 21 and price at 9, earning 21. Matching the stable pattern avoids disrupting a profitable repeated outcome.
The others have held at 7 each for eight rounds. Against their combined 14, producing 7 yields price 9 and profit 21; nearby quantities earn less, so maintain the stable outcome.
